progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ek4 and dwells most on C in Maqlub, Mokhalef, Forud & Daramad Sevvom Mokhalef. The line peaks at C5 (508.6 Hz) at 1:01.4. It closes on C4, not the tonic (Ek3 → C4 → C4 → C4 → C4 → C4).
